verse.verse_3: What do you comprehend by the concrete reality?
verse.verse_4: The Thamud and 'Ad denied the consequential calamity.
verse.verse_5: So destroyed were the Thamud by a storm of thunder and lightning;
verse.verse_6: And the 'Ad were destroyed by the furious cold blast of roaring wind
verse.verse_7: Which He sent to assail them for seven nights and eight days running. You should have seen the people prostrate like the decayed trunks of date-palm trees.
verse.verse_8: Do you see any trace of them?
verse.verse_9: Then came the Pharaoh, and those before him whose habitations were overthrown while they were committing crimes.
verse.verse_10: When they disobeyed the apostle of their Lord He seized them with an overwhelming punishment.
verse.verse_11: When the water rose in flood, We bore you in the ark,
verse.verse_12: In order to make it a warning for you, and that the ear retentive may preserve it.
verse.verse_13: When the single blast is sounded on the trumpet,
verse.verse_14: And the earth and mountains heaved and crushed to powder with one levelling blow,
verse.verse_15: On that Day will come what is to come.
verse.verse_16: The sky will cleave asunder on that day and fall to pieces.
verse.verse_17: On its fringes will be angels, eight of them, bearing their Lord's throne aloft.
verse.verse_18: You will then be set before Him, and not one of you will remain unexposed.
verse.verse_19: He who is given his ledger in his right hand, will say: "Here, read my ledger.
verse.verse_20: I was certain I'll be given my account."
verse.verse_21: So he shall have an agreeable life
verse.verse_23: With fruits hanging low within reach,
verse.verse_24: (And told:) "Eat and drink to your fill as reward for (good) deeds you had done in days of yore."
verse.verse_25: But whosoever gets his ledger in his left hand, will say: "Would that I were never given my ledger,
verse.verse_27: I wish death had put an end to me.
verse.verse_28: Of no use was even my wealth.
verse.verse_29: Vanished has my power from me."
verse.verse_31: Then cast him to be burnt in Hell;
verse.verse_32: And string him to a chain seventy cubits long.
verse.verse_33: He did not believe in God the supreme,
verse.verse_34: Nor urged others to feed the poor.
verse.verse_35: That is why he has no friend today,
verse.verse_37: Which none but the hellish eat."
verse.verse_38: So, I call to witness what you see
verse.verse_39: And what you do not see,
verse.verse_40: That this is indeed the word of the noble Messenger,
verse.verse_41: And not the word of a poet. How little is it that you believe!
verse.verse_42: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer. Little is it that you reflect!
verse.verse_43: It has been sent down by the Lord of all the worlds.
verse.verse_44: Had he attributed falsely any words to Us,
verse.verse_45: We would have seized him by his right hand,
verse.verse_47: And not one of you would have been able to stop (Us).
verse.verse_48: It is really a reminder for those who fear God and follow the straight path.
verse.verse_49: We certainly know that some among you do deny it.
verse.verse_50: It is surely the nemesis of unbelievers.
verse.verse_51: And He, He is indeed the ultimate Reality.
verse.verse_52: So glorify your Lord, the most supreme.
